audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Ziggs levels 1-5 and then went Skill for level 6, first item and 2+ items — exactly backwards. The TL;DR also opens 'Poke war on your terms', on a 35.71% matchup whose own content layer says 'you lose the raw poke war here'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Karma, Skill, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs. Karma's level 1 is her one favoured window (Mantra from level 1, no minefield yet); artillery out-scales her from level 3 onward and never gives the lane back.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Karma, row 1 to Skill, rows 4-6 to Ziggs on both layers; difficulty 7.5/10, carry threat 7/10; TL;DR rewritten to say she loses the poke war.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phase whys were Karma boilerplate about owning a toll booth.
audit.why: Ziggs' curve is Hexplosive Minefield at 3 (16s flat, zones every approach), Satchel Charge as an all-in denier, and a Liandry's/Luden's spike that makes minefield chip lethal under tower. Karma gets no level-6 spike.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[0..6].why to those spikes with the real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Satchel Charge was described only as 'his knockback escape' — the page never said what it does to Karma.
audit.why: It is a 20/18/16/14/12s displacement dealing percent max health, and Focused Resolve is a 675-range tether that must survive to root. Detonating Satchel knocks Karma out of tether range, so the root never resolves and her entire rotation whiffs. That is the decisive interaction and it appeared only in the content layer.
audit.corrected: Stated the displacement-breaks-tether interaction with both cooldown endpoints in winCon, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged four ability names as probably wrong.
audit.why: All four are false positives — Bouncing Bomb, Satchel Charge and Hexplosive Minefield are Ziggs' real names; the detector was matching leading verbs like 'Drop' and 'Hold'.

notes: The full layer's TL;DR ('Poke war on your terms') was the direct opposite of the content layer and of a 35.71% win rate — a Karma player reading only the loading-screen line would contest a poke war she loses. All four packet suspectNames are false positives. Hexplosive Minefield is 16s at every rank, which is unusual and worth keeping in the copy: it is the one repeatable window to shove.
